name: AWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top title, attested from its own digest; no reign is dated from the one document served this pass.

name: AWA North American Championship
epitaph: Changed hands at least once between two of the fed's own wrestlers, captured only in an undated recap montage on a later broadcast.
notes: A recap montage on Wednesday Night Warriors II (7 March 1997) shows Kevin Slater winning this title from Remy Boudreaux; no date for that match survives.

name: AWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's own tag title, attested from its own digest; no reign is dated from the one document served this pass.
